entities.summary: Mitsuharu Inoue was a Japanese writer of novels, short stories, poetry and essays, who has been associated with Japanese postwar literature and the Atomic bomb literature genre. Mitsuharu Inoue was a authors & novelists from Lüshunkou District (1926-05-15, Lüshunkou District–1992-05-30). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
